description:
Frontend Software Engineer — Secure Mission Systems 

 Location: Mainly remote, with onsite work in Laurel, Maryland, typically one day approximately every six weeks for team-wide sprint planning
 Clearance: Active final DoD Secret clearance required

 Build Secure Software for High-Impact Defense Missions 

 Build secure, interactive software that helps users understand complex information, evaluate options, and support mission-planning decisions.

 As a Frontend Software Engineer at Rackner, you will develop modern application features for secure mission-planning and decision-support software. You will build responsive user interfaces using React and TypeScript, support geospatial visualization using Cesium, and connect frontend components to services built with FastAPI and Flask.

 This role gives you broader ownership than isolated interface tickets. You will contribute across application development, API integration, automated testing, secure software delivery, documentation, and technical reviews while working with experienced software, AI/ML, security, platform, and customer engineering teams.

 This position is contingent upon contract award and final customer approval.

 What You’ll Do 

 
 Design, develop, test, and integrate frontend software features.

 Build responsive user interfaces using React and TypeScript.

 Develop map-based and geospatial visualization features using Cesium.

 Connect frontend components to APIs and services built with FastAPI and Flask.

 Turn complex mission and technical information into clear, usable workflows.

 Present application data and AI-enabled outputs in ways users can understand and use.

 Work within GitLab and OpenShift-based development environments.

 Apply secure software-development practices throughout implementation and testing.

 Write and maintain automated unit and integration tests.

 Participate in code reviews, technical reviews, and design discussions.

 Document application workflows, design decisions, interfaces, and test results.

 Collaborate with backend, AI/ML, security, platform, DevSecOps, and customer engineering teams.

 
 What You’ll Bring 

 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.

 At least four years of professional software-development experience.

 Hands-on experience building frontend applications with React and TypeScript.

 Using Cesium or CesiumJS for map-based or geospatial application features.

 Working with FastAPI and Flask in support of frontend-to-backend integration.

 Experience working with GitLab-based development workflows.

 Developing or deploying software in OpenShift environments.

 Understanding of secure software-development lifecycle practices.

 Writing and maintaining automated tests.

 Ability to write clear, maintainable, and testable code.

 Clear technical documentation and communication skills.

 
 Experience That Can Strengthen Your Fit 

 Experience with several of the following can improve alignment, but deep expertise in every area is not expected:

 
 Cesium, CesiumJS, or another geospatial or mapping framework

 Map-based, spatial, or data-visualization applications

 OpenShift, Kubernetes, or another containerized environment

 GitLab and secure CI/CD workflows

 FastAPI, Flask, Python, or API development

 Automated testing and vulnerability remediation

 Defense, aerospace, command-and-control, or mission-planning software

 Frontend integration of AI-assisted recommendations or decision-support capabilities

 
 Why Rackner 

 At Rackner, you will have the opportunity to build secure technology that supports critical defense and public-sector missions.

 You will work on more than isolated frontend requirements. This role brings together hands-on software development, interactive data experiences, secure delivery, API integration, and close collaboration across frontend, backend, AI/ML, security, platform, and mission-focused teams.

 Rackner has delivered more than $30 million in recent federal awards and supports mission-critical work across defense, civilian, and public-sector environments. We are looking for a Frontend Software Engineer who can build on that momentum by making complex information easier to understand, navigate, and act on.

 Benefits & Professional Growth 

 
 Competitive compensation

 Company-supported certifications aligned with current and future program work

 401(k) with 100% company match up to 6%

 Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage

 Paid time off and company holidays

 Remote-work support and home-office equipment plan

 Fitness and wellness reimbursement

 Weekly pay schedule

 Professional-development and future growth opportunities

 
 Apply 

 If you are a frontend engineer who wants to expand your impact across secure software, modern React and TypeScript development, data-rich interfaces, and mission-focused applications, we would like to hear from you.
